skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the economic value and components of natural resources, the necessity of valuing these resources, and the role of the appraiser.
Explain, construct, and select appropriate valuation processes for natural resources.
Apply knowledge to determine the value of specific types of natural resources and products/services.
Adhere to legal regulations regarding resource valuation.
Identify and propose solutions to issues encountered during valuation processes.
Work effectively in teams to choose topics and solve problems.
Demonstrate initiative in learning, research, and group work.
